full_judgment: Latifur Rahman, J: Plaintiff-respondent filed Title Suit No. 1169 of 1985 in the Court of Assistant Judge, 4th Court, Dhaka for recovery of Khas possession after ejectment of the defendant-licensees. The suit was decreed by the trial Court on 31.7.89. The defendants preferred Title Appeal No. 242 of 1989 before the District Judge, Dhaka and the same was dismissed by the Additional District Judge, 2nd Court, Dhaka on 5.10.94. Thereafter defendants filed Civil Revision No. 4215 of 1994 and the Rule issued thereon was discharged by a learned Single Judge of the High Court Division. The defendant-petitioners having lost in all the courts below have preferred this leave petition.
